title: Punar shared definitions
description: Shared $defs referenced by every Punar domain schema. Source of truth: docs/product/SPEC_v0.2.md sections 18, 19.1, 20, 28, 41, 52, 53. Reference from other schemas as {"$ref": "https://schemas.punar.dev/v1alpha1/common/defs.json#/$defs/<name>"}.

principal_kind.description: Identity types recognized as first-class principals (spec section 18).

decision.description: Policy decision values (spec section 20). Note: YAML manifest credential grants in spec examples also use the domain-specific value 'request' (equivalent intent to approval_required); that value belongs to manifest credential-mode enums, not to this runtime decision enum.

capability_id.description: Dotted-path capability identifier with snake_case segments, e.g. 'security.firewall', 'system.install_package' (spec sections 28, 41). Policy explain paths such as 'security.diskEncryption' are YAML config paths, not capability ids, and do not use this def.

agent_session_id.description: AI agent session identifier, 'agt_' prefix (spec sections 19.2, 28, 53).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. The pattern is asserted because 'format' is annotation-only in draft 2020-12 default vocabulary.

agent_classification.description: AI Agent Registry classification (spec section 19.1). 'unknown' covers the spec's UNKNOWN / SUSPECTED class.
